defect.summary: consumer_closure._header_callback_param admits preprocessor directives and their backslash-continued macro bodies as declarations. Macro argument expressions are then classified as parameter types, so the non-callback arm refuses the real callback declaration (eight sites), and differing macro call texts break the consistency arm (PEM_ASN1_read_bio).

change.mechanism: _without_preprocessor blanks every line whose first non-space character is '#' and every physical line continued by a trailing backslash, replacing non-newline characters with spaces so offsets and line numbers are preserved. It is applied to the header texts inside _header_callback_param only, before the typedef and declaration scans.
